_comment.tracking: link detections / merge broken ids when boxes overlap (IoU or half of overlap-over-smaller-box) within max_gap_s
_comment.clip_fps: 10 fps everywhere: with the 50-frame minimum per SAM request, 10 fps costs within ~20% of a 5 fps + 10 fps-around-the-drop hybrid on these clip lengths, and avoids a variable-rate timeline
_comment.score_v1.drop_speed_min: centroid downward speed in frame-heights per second, measured over drop_window_s
_comment.score_v1.drop_min: total centroid drop across the merged event, fraction of frame height
_comment.score_v1.ar_*: box aspect ratio = height/width. tall >= ar_tall_min before, wide <= ar_wide_max after
_comment.score_v1.low_hold_s: seconds the person must stay low after the drop ends; clips that end early use the available tail if >= min_post_s and allow_clip_end
_comment.score_v1.low_*: a frame counts as low if ar <= low_ar_max OR cy >= post-drop cy - low_cy_margin
_comment.score_v1.min_post_s: when the clip ends before low_hold_s, accept the tail if it is at least this long (dataset clips are trimmed right after impact)
_comment.score_v2: units are body lengths (median of max(box h, box w) in the 1 s before the drop). drop_rel_min = total centroid drop, drop_speed_rel_min = peak speed over drop_window_s, ar_wide_max = median box h/w after the drop, no_getup_s = seconds without a get-up (ar >= getup_ar_min or centroid rising >= getup_rise_rel body lengths); hold is 'unknown' when the clip ends first and still counts as flagged
_comment.trigger: looser DROP-only thresholds for the always-on YOLO stage that decides when to call SAM
_comment.spark: burst_before_s/after_s bound the 10 fps burst around the drop sent as a video file; frames_fps is used only with --frames. max_output_tokens includes reasoning tokens.
_comment.audio.output: camera (Tapo speaker via go2rtc) or laptop (afplay); one-line switch
_comment.checkin: language picks the prompt and Kokoro voice; help_words force needs_help before Spark; recheck_after_s = still-down time after an 'okay' that triggers another check-in
_comment.monitor: still_down_s: seconds down after a confirmed drop before the event upgrades; floor_still_s: seconds on floor/rug barely moving (no drop needed); still_move_max_bl: centroid movement over 2 s in body lengths that still counts as 'barely moving'; zones_file: zones.json at the project root, written by `remy setup-zones`
_comment.alerts.family: placeholder; real numbers live in family.json at the project root (gitignored) with the same shape. With a WhatsApp test number each recipient must be on the app's allow-list and must message the number first (24 h window).
_comment.alerts.channel: whatsapp (Meta Cloud API; .env WHATSAPP_TOKEN + WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID) or twilio (WhatsApp sandbox; .env TWILIO_*)
_comment.checkin.escalate_on_unclear: only a clear okay is reassuring: unclear/incoherent replies escalate at once; no answer gets retries_no_answer more prompts first
_comment.triage: backend judges the fall and writes the family note; reply_backend classifies the spoken reply. spark = Muse Spark 1.3 on the Meta Model API (the default for both). spark_open = Muse Spark Open (open weights) on Fireworks, kept as an alternative that was compared clip for clip in eval/TRIAGE_COMPARE.md; it falls back to spark with a warning when FIREWORKS_API_KEY is missing.
_comment.yolo.model: weights file at the project root (ultralytics downloads it on first use)
_comment.alerts.heartbeat: once a day at `hour` (local time) the family gets a short 'Remy is watching' message with uptime, events in the last 24 h and camera reconnects. A monitor started after that hour waits for the next day, so restarts never message anyone. Off for file sources.
_comment.monitor.reconnect: a dropped camera stream is reopened with back-off (2, 4, 8 ... 60 s); `remy run --max-outage-s` sets when to give up and exit so a supervisor can restart
_comment.spark_open: Muse Spark Open on a partner endpoint, OpenAI-compatible; the burst goes as JPEG frames at frames_fps. Not used unless triage.backend or reply_backend says spark_open. Any OpenAI-compatible host works: change base_url, model and api_key_env.
_comment.checkin.stop_on_silence: the mic recording ends once speech (>= speech_db for speech_min_s, or one chunk >= loud_db) is followed by silence_s below silence_db, never before min_s; with no speech it runs to record_s. Levels are dBFS from the Tapo mic: gated silence ~-72, rustle -50 to -42, speech from the floor -35 to -20.
_comment.checkin.escalate_on_unheard_speech: if speech-level sound was heard but the transcript is empty, the reply counts as unclear (she tried to answer, we could not understand) and escalates at once instead of a second prompt
